name: Bandai FCG-1/2 / LZ93D50

components.role: Bandai FCG ASIC with 16 KiB PRG banking, eight 1 KiB CHR bank outputs, four-mode CIRAM routing and CPU-cycle IRQ counter
Optional 256-byte serial EEPROM on LZ93D50 boards; absent on FCG-1/2

notes: Mapper 16 submapper 4 selects FCG-1/2: registers respond in CPU $6000-$7FFF and IRQ low/high writes directly alter the running counter. Submapper 5 selects LZ93D50: registers respond in $8000-$FFFF, IRQ writes fill a reload latch, and optional 256-byte 24C02 EEPROM is exposed through the ASIC serial port. Submapper 0 accepts both documented register windows for legacy compatibility. Deprecated submappers 1/2/3 are intentionally rejected in favor of mapper 159/157/153, which represent distinct fitted hardware.
